Frequently Asked Questions

What does the best salon interior designer in Hauz Khas focus on?

A layout that keeps clients comfortable, staff efficient and the brand visible. Hauz Khas has many style-led salons, so a distinct look and a smooth client journey both matter.

Can you plan a salon on an upper floor?

Yes. Upper-floor salons need a clear entry, good signage and a welcoming first view from the stairs or lift. We also check water supply and drainage for wash stations early.

How do you keep salon interiors durable?

We use finishes that resist water, heat and hair-care chemicals, with easy-to-clean floors and counters, so the salon keeps its look with daily use.

Why choose the best salon interior designer for a refit?

A refit is a chance to fix layout problems, not just repaint. A specialist spots what slows the team down and plans the new design around it.
